headline: Spain and Italy impose border checks in migration row
summary: Spain began checking travelers from Italy for a month, after Italy suspended Schengen following an influx of about 78,000 migrants into Ceuta.
script: Spain and Italy are now checking travellers at their borders. The row follows about seventy eight thousand migrants entering Spain's Ceuta enclave. Both countries say the checks will last around a month, as a wider EU migration debate deepens.
imageAlt: Spanish police check travel documents at an airport arrival area.
imageAltTwo: Migrants wait near a temporary centre at Spain's Ceuta border.
